_comment: Swedish source budget for ai_agent_core. code = Swedish string literals (AST, docstrings excluded) in non-exempt files. doc = Swedish docstrings, tracked so the debt is visible but not enforced. The ceiling only ratchets down: test_baseline_does_not_claim_more_than_reality fails when a recorded ceiling sits above the real count.

_exempt.migrations/: Historical code already run in production. Only comments and docstrings may be touched; a literal used in an env lookup or a comparison stays as it is (see LANGUAGE_EXEMPT).

_data_keys_note: Swedish field names in the sv_SE view-translation guard are DATA (keys that must map to English), not UI text. Exempt by key.
_xml_note: Swedish text in UI-rendering XML attributes (string/help/placeholder/confirm), per file. Same ratchet as the code count: a file may not grow.

_sv_po.note: state before task 10. The 450 Swedish msgid are the defect: there is no English original to translate from. Reference for task 10.3.

_suite_baseline.note: The 16 failures / 776 errors are PRE-EXISTING: the same numbers come out on a clean HEAD without the language gate (verified 2026-11-08). The gate adds 6 passing tests and no new failures. Errors are dominated by environment issues (HTTP port, duplicate-key fixtures, _embedding_provider assertion on ai.provider).

_data_literals.note: Remaining Swedish literals are DATA: transliteration table, field names in domains, and regexes that must match Swedish LLM answers. Exempt with a written reason in LANGUAGE_DATA_LITERALS.

_contracts_note: tests/language_contracts.json was re-snapshotted 2026-11-08 after ac42d816 ("[FIX] views: tree -> list") added first_token_seconds, longest_gap_seconds and stream_seconds to views/ai_session_views.xml. That is another author view change, not a translation. From here on, any contract diff is a translation regression.

_permanent_swedish.core/tool_select.py: Swedish query terms in the lexical fallback bridge (_BRIDGE), the bilingual stopword list (_STOP) and the Swedish stem entries. Tool descriptions are English; prompts are often Swedish. These keys are the mapping itself.
_permanent_swedish.core/verify.py: Swedish text analysis: the source-claim regex, the proper-noun and sentence-start character classes, the sv/en language-detection word lists and the entity stopwords. Translating them would break entity extraction and citation checking.
_permanent_swedish.models/ai_coworker.py: Data: transliteration table, beställare_* field names, narration/meta-note regexes, and the stored name "Allmän".
_permanent_swedish.models/ai_mail_test_wizard.py: Data: two f-string fragments already translated in context.
